extras.quota_verbatim: No published per-account total; 480 MB per file, lossless only (WAV/FLAC/AIFF, 16 or 24-bit, 44.1 or 48 kHz, 1-2 channels).
extras.limits_verbatim: 480 MB per file; strict format spec (bit depth, sample rate, channel count all constrained); a track must be submitted to a Jamendo programme, so there is a review step.
extras.egress_verbatim: Free streaming and free download for listeners; Jamendo monetises through licensing, not storage fees.
extras.chaining_verbatim: Unlimited tracks per artist account x 480 MB. Same shape as Bandcamp but with a larger per-file cap and no sales gate.
extras.tooling_verbatim: Jamendo Artist web dashboard; licensing API exists for consumers of the catalogue, not for uploads.
extras.agent_focus: Audio and podcast hosting where per-episode caps are large and hosts accept arbitrary files disguised as audio. Crux: does the RSS enclosure serve the ORIGINAL uploaded bytes from a permanent URL, or a re-encoded house stream?

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
